cases.title: After the pass and the closing question, 'let's finish up': the close never names a slash command (the panel has no command line)

rubric.reason: Turn 6 names the next step only in panel terms ('Next time, try a review on a move you haven't shaped yet, like the End of Bar's Trim Paths'), with no slash command or typed or terminal step, then gives the play-it-back line.

Each turn is short and moves one idea: turn 3 confirms the reading, gives the two influence sentences and the task, and ends on 'say done' with one demo offer; turn 4 is 'That passes' plus the read-again question; turns 5 and 6 each end with something to do ('Play it back at full speed', 'play Subtitle back at full speed').
